name: Kinesis Gold
oneLiner: KAU is Kinesis Gold, a token redeemable for one gram of LBMA-approved physical gold held in allocated ABX vaults, with transaction-fee yield sharing.
collateral: LBMA-approved physical gold bullion (1 KAU = 1 gram, 999.9 fineness), held in fully allocated, insured vaults globally via ABX (Allocated Bullion Exchange)
pegMechanism: Direct redemption for physical gold through Kinesis; yield via transaction fee sharing

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: KAU resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

mintAuthority.summary: KAU is issued by Kinesis (Cayman VASP); each token is minted by the issuer when LBMA-approved physical gold is allocated into ABX vaults and redeemed against physical gold, with supply controlled by the centralized issuer backend.

controls.label: Kinesis issuance backend (gold allocation)
controls.evidence: Kinesis mints KAU against allocated LBMA-approved physical gold held in fully allocated, insured ABX/Brink's/Loomis vaults (audited by Bureau Veritas) and burns on physical redemption; the regulated issuer controls supply creation.

review.evidence: Kinesis materials describe KAU as a 1:1 claim on one gram of allocated LBMA-approved gold, minted/redeemed through the issuer against vaulted bullion with semi-annual Bureau Veritas audits; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.
review.sourceFreeRationale: On-chain token owner/minter admin for the Ethereum KAU contract was not read live in this pass; classification rests on the issuer-allocated-bullion mint model.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain owner/minter admin and any proxy admin for the KAU Ethereum contract.
